label: Ink & Watercolor
description: Expressive ink lines and transparent washes; suited to atmospheric journeys and intimate observation.
rendering: An immersive scene painted in transparent watercolor with expressive pen-and-ink contours. A continuous coloured underwash covers the entire image beneath the scene, including every edge and corner; layered scenery continues beyond the crop.
palette: Transparent layers of ochre, sienna, indigo and sage over the continuous coloured underwash; luminous highlights belong to objects and light within the scene.
lighting: Luminous light within the depicted space; shadows as cool layered washes.
materials: Confident ink contours, wet-in-wet blooms and granulating pigment across the whole depicted space.
composition: Compose a close crop inside a larger continuous scene. Foreground, surrounding space and background remain painted through all four corners; edges cut through scenery rather than outlining an illustration.
negatives: No bare white or cream paper, paper margins, unpainted corners, fading peripheral washes, vignette, border, sheet edges, sketchbook, tape or blank backdrop. Never place an illustration on a page or photograph a painted object. Avoid photorealism, digital airbrush smoothness and cartoon caricature.
